t: Именами участников спецоперации названы 363 улицы в России
d: В российских регионах продолжают увековечивать память военнослужащих, в том числе присваивая их имена улицам, скверам и образовательным учреждениям.
te: The names of the participants of the special operation named 363 streets in Russia
de: Russian regions continue to perpetuate the memory of servicemen, including by assigning their names to streets, squares and educational institutions.

te: Goremykin: more than 20 initiatives have simplified the receipt of benefits by the participants of the SVO
de: The new measures allowed to expand social support for military personnel, reduce payment terms and simplify the employment of veterans.

de: The country should not allow that will become an accomplice to the Ukrainian conflict, said Jean-Luc Mélenchon.
